title: Source, prose, and the optional visual
takeaway: The visual has its own review route. Its removal does not remove the topic prose.
assumptions: Positions show responsibilities and handoffs, not process count or execution time. One writer represents the parallel topic writers. Visual review includes critic and repair generation calls.

entities.label: Main-process evidence preparation
entities.summary: Builds planner context and source context for each topic.

entities.label: Planner
entities.summary: Returns ordered topics, hunk assignments, a story arc, and optional diagram briefs.

entities.label: Parallel topic writers
entities.summary: Generate topic prose and optional SVG illustrations from supplied source context.

entities.label: Isolated SVG renderer
entities.summary: Uses a separate sandboxed BrowserWindow with no preload, Node integration, network access, or shared app session.

entities.label: Educational visual review
entities.summary: Uses source and rendered images to judge the picture, with at most one repair.

entities.label: Topic collection and final text
entities.summary: Collects slides, refines explanation text, and reconciles the overview with completed topics.

relationships.label: Supply planning evidence
relationships.summary: Passes planner context and the hunk index to planReview.

relationships.label: Direct topic writing
relationships.summary: The main process orders planned topics and supplies their direction through topic context.

relationships.label: Supply topic source
relationships.summary: Builds topic context from assigned hunks, file contents, neighbor files, and planning direction.

relationships.label: Validate optional SVG
relationships.summary: Sends the normalized illustration to the browser validator supplied by the main process.

relationships.label: Supply rendered images
relationships.summary: Returns contact sheets that visual review supplies to the critic.

relationships.label: Supply source and illustration
relationships.summary: Passes the writer's source context, illustration, and browser render to independent visual review.

relationships.label: Render one repair
relationships.summary: Normalizes a repair candidate and renders it before another critique.

relationships.label: Keep topic prose
relationships.summary: The main process copies the writer narrative into the collected slide.

relationships.label: Return SVG or null through writer output
relationships.summary: Visual review changes only the illustration field; the main process copies that field into the slide.

plan.question: Where does source evidence go, and where can a picture be removed without losing prose?
plan.visualApproach: Use a connected responsibility map with a direct prose route and a separate browser-and-critic route for the optional SVG.
plan.whyThisForm: Separate routes make the prose boundary visible. The repair loop returns to browser checks instead of going directly to collection.
plan.encodings: Boxes name responsibilities. Arrows name supplied data. The dashed outline marks browser isolation. The SVG-or-null return shows that the picture is optional.
plan.motion: Use a static map. The question concerns ownership and handoffs; visible branches show acceptance, repair, and omission without simulating one execution.
plan.prediction: If visual review returns omit, collection still receives topic prose but receives no SVG.
plan.restingState: All responsibilities, the prose route, the visual route, and the repair loop remain visible.

scenarios.title: Parallel review responsibilities
scenarios.input: A topic writer produces prose and an optional SVG.

frames.title: Prose survives visual omission
frames.caption: Visual review returns an accepted SVG or null. A repair must return through rendering and critique before acceptance.
